name: convergence_integrate
description: Convergence spike (roadmap H1): finalize one wave — rebase its forks onto the moving shared branch head (NO big-bang merge), RELEASE the wave's file ownership so blocked items can dispatch next wave, and RECORD each agent's real spend on the blackboard so budget_gate_check can gate the next wave. A fork that edited the frozen contract becomes a controlled event (reopened, not merged); a rebase conflict reopens its item with the precise mechanism.

sharedRepo.description: The shared run worktree whose branch head advances as forks integrate.

sharedBranch.description: The shared branch name being advanced by fast-forward only.

correlationId.description: Run id; reopen/controlled-event facts are posted here.

contractPaths.description: Frozen contract paths; a fork touching these is a controlled event.

groupIds.description: Comma-separated fork ids dispatched this wave (from convergence_build_forks).

dispatched.description: This wave's dispatched items [{id, description, files, attempt}]; their ownership is released after integration and failed ones may be re-queued.

remaining.description: Items build_forks did not dispatch this wave (blocked by a live owner); carried into nextPending unchanged.

maxAttempts.description: Per-item attempt cap: a retryable failure (empty_delivery/rebase_conflict) is re-queued until attempts reach this, then becomes a terminal reopen.

joined.description: The wave's FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC output; per-fork costUsd/tokenUsed/model are recorded as spend facts.

integrated.description: Forks that delivered a commit, rebased cleanly, and advanced the shared head, in order.

reopened.description: TERMINAL failures only (frozen-contract edit, or a retryable failure that exhausted its attempt budget), each naming the precise mechanism.

retry.description: Retryable failures (empty_delivery/rebase_conflict) under the attempt cap, re-queued with attempt+1.

nextPending.description: The next wave's pending set: this wave's undispatched 'remaining' plus the re-queued 'retry' items.

controlledEvents.description: Subset of reopened that edited the frozen contract.

big_bang_merge.description: Always false — the integrator never does a big-bang merge; this is the H1 invariant under test.

final_head.description: The shared branch head after continuous integration.

releasedFiles.description: Count of file-ownership releases emitted for this wave's dispatched items.

spendRecorded.description: Count of per-fork spend facts recorded on the blackboard for this wave.
